task.title: Warm the hosted origin when the desktop shell launches
task.description: Follow-up from WB-01M0DT46WN (2026-08-20): a cold desktop launch pays Neon Auth JWKS + mint_jwt + a Render cold-start round trip serially AFTER the webview asks for / (observed 13s on a cold Render). Firing a cheap warm-up request (e.g. HEAD or GET a health route on the hosted origin, and optionally the JWKS fetch) from the shell at process start would overlap the wake with splash time and cut worst-case time-to-app substantially. Diff would live in src-tauri/ next to the /__loading splash (see specs/architecture-spike.md startup-timeline Findings).
